meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进计划执行,并行调度多个子代理完成工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你制定好计划后希望一键执行并分派给子代理
copy.tagline_en: Execute your plan and orchestrate parallel subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want to execute it with subagents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成项目执行的「总指挥」:它自己不动手写代码或改文件,而是把实现、测试、检查等每一项工作分派给子代理并行去做,同时维护计划进度和证据记录,直到计划里的所有任务都完成。
howto.when: 当你在制定好计划后说「开始工作」「执行计划」等指令,或要求运行 .omo/plans 目录下的某个计划时,这个技能就会接管。

say.note: 触发技能,开始按计划推进。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it never writes code or edits product files itself. It delegates implementation, tests, QA, and review to spawned subagents running in parallel, while maintaining plan progress, Boulder state, and an evidence ledger until every checkbox is complete.
howto.when_en: Triggers after planning when the user says "start work", "execute plan", etc., or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.
